newsitem.title: PERU: Peru credit to private sector up 4.1 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Peru credit to private sector up 4.1 pct in April.

text.p: Credit from Peru's banking system to the private sector stood at 32.698 billion soles at the end of April, up 4.1 percent in nominal terms from the end of March, the Central Reserve Bank said Tuesday.
Local currency loans stood at 8.075 billion soles at the end of April, up 2.2 percent from the end of March, while foreign currency loans were $9.257 billion, up 4.4 percent.
In nominal terms, credit was up 48.2 percent by the end of last year from 19.873 billion at the close of 1995.
